statement: A witness in a capital case must not act as judge
note: C0949 states the single-witness rule (Rambam's N288); Rambam reads this verse as barring a witness from judging the case.

statement: Do not accept ransom to spare a convicted murderer
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: Do not accept ransom to release a manslayer from refuge early
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: A judge must not fear a litigant or intimidator
note: C0959 itemizes the fear clause of 1:17.

statement: Do not appoint a judge unlearned in the law
note: Rambam reads 1:17 as barring unfit appointments; C0958 states impartiality; C0956 (1:13, Command) only requires choosing qualified judges.

statement: Do not desire (crave) another's possessions
note: Hebrew 5:18 is Saints 5:21 (5:18 there is 'murder'); Decalogue covet records, which do not split coveting from desiring.

statement: Believe that God is One
note: No unity record at 6:4 (S111 there is about love); C0985 (4:39) states the Lord alone is God.

statement: Love God
note: Covenant charge under Mosaic Command, consistent with the catalogue's scheme; Gospel study K002 also itemizes.

statement: Recite the Shema morning and evening
note: C0990 (6:7, 11:19) gives the plain sense, speaking God's words when lying down and rising; not framed as twice-daily recital.

statement: Study Torah and teach it
note: Teaching children itemized by C0978 (4:9-10, 11:19) and C0990; personal study is not separately stated.

statement: Wear tefillin on the head
note: C0117 (Ex 13:9, Deut 11:18) 'before the eyes'; Saints reads 'immovable before your eyes'; catalogue leaves the sign's form open.

statement: Bind tefillin on the arm
note: C0117 (Ex 13:9, Deut 11:18) 'sign on the hand'; no record at 6:8 itself; physical form left open.

statement: Affix God's words (mezuzah) to doorposts and gates
note: Standing household rule like tassels (C0860, Torah Law), yet C0991 is Mosaic Instruction.

statement: Fear God
note: No fear record at 6:13 or 10:20; C0610 (Lev 19:14) itemizes; AUD-03-25-17 (Law) names fear only as motive.

statement: Do not test God (or His true prophet) unduly
note: Plain-sense match; Rambam applies it to over-testing an established true prophet.

statement: Do not show mercy or favor to idolaters
note: C0997 is a historical direction, though AUD-05-20-17 labels the same devotion judgment (20:17-18) Torah Law.

statement: Do not intermarry with idolatrous nations
note: Standing marriage prohibition filed as historical direction; comparable assembly restrictions (23:3-4, C1143-C1144) are Torah Law.

statement: Do not fear the enemy in battle
note: Saints 7:21 reads 'not be wounded'; C1091 (20:1-4) is historical direction amid Deut 20 war laws labeled Law/Instruction.

statement: Do not benefit from idols' silver or gold ornaments
note: Two Law records split coveting and taking.

statement: Do not bring an idol or its accessories into your house
note: Exact match; C1002 (Command) adds rejecting it.

statement: Bless God after eating (grace after meals)
note: Exact match; Instruction label fits the hortatory context of 8:10-11.

statement: Love the convert (sojourner)
note: C0641 (Lev 19:34) carries Deut 10:19 as Additional Scripture.

statement: Cleave to God (by associating with Torah sages)
note: C0993 (Saints 6:13 adds 'cleave') and S119 state cleaving to the Lord; Rambam's sages application not stated.

statement: Swear by God's name when an oath is required
note: C0994 at parallel 6:13; 10:20 itself only in S119 (cleaving).

statement: Destroy idols and their places of worship
note: C0242 (Ex 23:24 with Deut 12:2-3) is historical direction; catalogue treats it as conquest-specific.

statement: Do not destroy holy places or erase God's name
note: S122 reads 12:4 as not worshipping God by pagan practices; Rambam's ban on destroying holy things is not stated.

statement: Bring vowed and freewill offerings at the next pilgrimage festival
note: No record at 12:5-6; C0571 (Lev 17:3-5) requires bringing sacrifices to the sanctuary; the festival timing is not stated.

statement: Do not offer sacrifices outside the chosen place
note: Exact match; Lev 17:8-9 attached.

statement: Offer all sacrifices only at the chosen place
note: 12:14 itself only in S124; C0571 (Lev 17:3-5) states the positive rule, C1015 the negative.

statement: Redeem consecrated animals that became blemished
note: AUD-05-12-15 reads 12:15 as permitting ordinary local slaughter; Rambam's redemption of blemished offerings is not stated.

statement: Do not eat second-tithe grain outside Jerusalem
note: C1016 bundles all 12:17 sacred foods in one prohibition on eating them in ordinary towns.

statement: Do not drink second-tithe wine outside Jerusalem
note: C1016 bundles all 12:17 sacred foods in one prohibition on eating them in ordinary towns.

statement: Do not consume second-tithe oil outside Jerusalem
note: C1016 bundles all 12:17 sacred foods in one prohibition on eating them in ordinary towns.

statement: Do not eat an unblemished firstborn outside Jerusalem
note: C1016 bundles all 12:17 sacred foods in one prohibition on eating them in ordinary towns.

statement: Priests must not eat sin or guilt offerings outside the court
note: Positive location rules (Lev 6:19; 7:6) itemize it; C1016 at 12:17 states only the lay sacred-food rule.

statement: Do not eat the meat of a burnt offering
note: C1016 holds 12:17 but states the eat-at-sanctuary rule; Rambam's ban on eating burnt offerings is not stated.

statement: Do not eat lesser offerings before their blood is sprinkled
note: C1016 holds 12:17; the before-sprinkling prohibition is not stated.

statement: Priests must not eat firstfruits before placing them in the court
note: C1016 lists 'firstfruits of your hands' but states only the place rule, not this timing.

statement: Do not neglect giving the Levites their dues
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: Slaughter animals by the prescribed method before eating
note: AUD-05-12-15 states permission for local slaughter; the commanded slaughter method ('as I commanded you') is not stated.

statement: Do not eat a limb from a living animal
note: C0019 (Gen 9:4, with 12:23-25) states the blood prohibition; eating flesh from a living animal is not itemized.

statement: Bring offerings from outside the Land to the sanctuary
note: No record at 12:26; C0571 (Lev 17:3-5) gives only the general bring-to-sanctuary rule.

statement: Do not add to the Torah's commandments
note: C0975 (4:2) carries 13:1 as Additional Scripture.

statement: Do not subtract from the Torah's commandments
note: C0976 (4:2) carries 13:1 as Additional Scripture.

statement: Do not listen to a prophet speaking for idolatry
note: Exact match at 13:4.

statement: Do not love the enticer to idolatry
note: Plain sense 'do not consent' fits C1019 (13:4); C1021 bars sparing from attachment; not loving him is not stated.

statement: Do not stop hating the enticer to idolatry
note: C1019 gives the plain sense 'do not hearken'; Rambam's reading, keep hating the enticer, is not stated.

statement: Do not save the enticer from death
note: C1021 itemizes 'your eye shall not spare him'.

statement: Do not plead in the enticer's defense
note: C1021 covers not sparing or pitying him; Rambam reads 'pity' as arguing for acquittal.

statement: Do not withhold incriminating evidence against the enticer
note: C1022 (do not conceal) plus C1023 (report him, Instruction).

statement: Do not entice an individual to idolatry
note: C1025 holds 13:12 but states the death judgment; the prohibition on enticing itself has no record.

statement: Examine witnesses thoroughly
note: Diligent-inquiry procedures (13:13-15, 17:2-4, 19:18); case-specific, no general witness-examination rule.

statement: Burn the city condemned for apostasy
note: Burning is Instruction (a procedural step); the sword judgment at 13:16 is C1027 (Law).

statement: Do not rebuild the apostate city
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: Do not benefit from the apostate city's property
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: Do not make a bald spot in mourning for the dead
note: For Israel only topical study S126; Torah Law C0655 (Lev 21:5) covers priests only.

statement: Do not eat consecrated animals that became disqualified
note: Rambam reads 'no abominable thing' as disqualified offerings; only the 18-verse food study S127 holds 14:3.

statement: Do not eat unclean land animals
note: C0467 (Lev 11:2-8) carries Deut 14:7-8.

statement: Eat only clean birds, distinguishing them by their signs
note: Permissive form at the source verse; examining the signs is implied, not stated.

statement: Do not eat unclean flying insects
note: Parallel C0471 (Lev 11:20-23); Deut 14:19 itself only in S127.

statement: Do not eat an animal that died by itself
note: C0672 (Lev 22:8, priests) names Deut 14:21 as Israel's parallel but does not cite it; 14:21 itself only in S128.

statement: Separate the second tithe for eating in Jerusalem
note: No record at 14:22-23; generic produce tithe C0759 (Lev 27:30) and eat-at-chosen-place C1016 together cover it.

statement: Separate the poor man's tithe in the third year
note: Standing poor-relief rule like gleanings (C0601, Torah Law), yet C1034 is Mosaic Instruction.

statement: Do not demand repayment of debts released in the seventh year
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: Release loans in the seventh year
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: Exact debts from a foreigner
note: Both records hold 15:3 but state only the release for an Israelite brother; the foreigner clause is not itemized.

statement: Do not withhold charity from the poor
note: Rambam's single prohibition is split into hardening heart and closing hand.

statement: Give charity to the poor
note: Negative counterparts C1037-C1038 are Torah Law; the positive duty is Instruction (15:8) and Command (Lev 25:35).

statement: Do not refuse a loan because the release year nears
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: Do not send a freed Hebrew servant away empty-handed
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: Give parting gifts to a freed Hebrew servant
note: Its negative twin C1042 (15:13) is Torah Law; the positive duty at 15:14 is Instruction.

statement: Do not work consecrated (firstborn) animals
note: Firstborn calf record; Rambam extends it to all consecrated animals.

statement: Do not shear consecrated (firstborn) animals
note: Firstborn sheep record; Rambam extends it to all consecrated animals.

statement: Do not gash yourselves in mourning or idolatrous rites
note: Batch source 16:1 is wrong; Rambam cites 14:1 (Saints 'purification rites'). C0633 (Lev 19:28) bars mourning incisions.

statement: Do not eat leaven after midday on Passover eve
note: C0106 holds 16:3 for the seven-day leaven ban; the eve-afternoon prohibition is not stated.

statement: Do not leave festival (chagigah) meat until the third day
note: C0099 reads 16:4 as the Passover-overnight rule (Rambam's N117); the chagigah rule is not stated.

statement: Rejoice on the festivals
note: Booths (C0703, with 16:14-15) and Weeks (C1050, Instruction); no general festival-rejoicing record.

statement: Appoint judges and officers in every town
note: Standing law at 16:18 has only S135; C0956 (1:13, Command) is a one-time appointment that notes 16:18.

statement: Do not plant a tree (asherah) beside the altar
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: Do not set up a pillar for worship
note: Parallel C0738 (Lev 26:1); 16:22 itself only in S136.

statement: Do not sacrifice an animal with a temporary blemish
note: C0675 carries 17:1 as a general blemish ban; Rambam reads 17:1 as temporary blemishes.

statement: Obey the rulings of the supreme court
note: Negative twin C1056 is Torah Law; obeying the ruling is filed as referral procedure (Instruction).

statement: Do not deviate from the supreme court's rulings
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: Appoint a king from among Israel
note: Framed conditionally (when establishing a ruler).

statement: Do not appoint a foreigner as king
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: Do not settle in Egypt
note: C1062 states the return-to-Egypt prohibition for all Israel.

statement: The king must not multiply horses
note: Exact match; C1061 adds sending the people to Egypt for horses.

statement: The king must not take many wives
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: The king must not amass excessive silver and gold
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: The king must write a Torah scroll for himself
note: The king's prohibitions (C1060-C1064) are Torah Law; his scroll duty is Instruction.

statement: Levites must not receive a territorial inheritance
note: C0881 (Num 18:20) carries Deut 18:1-2.

statement: Levites must not take a share of war spoils
note: C0881 holds 18:1 for land inheritance only; Rambam reads 'portion' as spoils.

statement: Give the priest the foreleg, cheeks and stomach
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: Give the priest terumah from grain, wine and oil
note: AUD-05-18-4 at 18:4 covers only fleece; C0798 (Num 18:12-13) gives the grain, wine and oil firstfruits.

statement: Give the priest the first fleece
note: Exact match at the source verse.

statement: Priestly courses serve in rotation, all equally at festivals
note: Records give the incoming Levite's equal service and share; the rotation of courses is not stated.

statement: Do not practice soothsaying (me'onen)
note: C1071 'interprets spoken omens' renders me'onen; N31-N33 assumed in Deut 18:10 order.

statement: Do not practice augury or omen-reading (menachesh)
note: Deut 18:10 augury clause lacks its own record; Lev 19:26 parallels C0629-C0630 itemize it.

statement: Do not practice sorcery
note: Exact match at 18:10.

statement: Do not cast spells (charming)
note: Exact match at 18:11.

statement: Do not consult a medium (ov)
note: Saints 18:11 reads 'is a medium' (C1074, practising); consulting is itemized at Lev 19:31 (C0637).

statement: Do not consult a familiar-spirit diviner (yidoni)
note: Saints 18:11 'observes portents' (C1075, practising); turning to enchanters at Lev 19:31 (C0638) covers consulting.

statement: Do not seek knowledge from the dead
note: Exact match at 18:11.
